name: text-gif
title: Text GIF
blurb: Text with animated GIF or video overlay.
description: Text element combined with animated media (GIF, video, or animation frames) creating a compound effect.
use_when: Eye-catching headlines paired with motion graphics or looping video.
avoid_when: Performance-sensitive contexts — video overlays add memory overhead.
a11y: Text is readable but media is unpaused and non-interactive.
